scope: Ten selected chronology cases from the existing annotations. Narrative order, not a uniform absolute chronology. No flag does not establish historicity. This is not an exhaustive academic audit of all biblical events.

events.title: Camels in Abraham’s household
events.traditional_date: Patriarchal / traditionally Bronze Age; no absolute date in Genesis
events.academic_consensus: Significant domestic use in the Aravah: last third of the tenth century BCE or later

events.title: Isaac meets the king of the Philistines
events.traditional_date: Patriarchal / traditionally Bronze Age; no absolute date in Genesis
events.academic_consensus: Philistine cultural transition at Ashkelon: early Iron Age, twelfth century BCE

additional_sources.label: Feldman et al. (2019) · full research article

events.title: Joseph’s seven-year famine
events.traditional_date: Joseph’s lifetime; no absolute date in Genesis

events.title: Joseph’s land acquisition
events.traditional_date: During the famine; no absolute date in Genesis

events.title: The fall of Jericho
events.traditional_date: After the wilderness journey; c.1400 BCE in an early-conquest reconstruction
events.academic_consensus: Sampled Middle Bronze destruction: late seventeenth / sixteenth century BCE (1995 calibration)

events.title: Sennacherib’s campaign in Judah
events.review_status: Campaign date corroborated; narrative details require separate assessment

events.title: Darius the Mede receives the kingdom
events.traditional_date: After Belshazzar’s death; apparently before Cyrus in Daniel 5–6

events.title: Cyrus’s proclamation and the return
events.traditional_date: Cyrus’s first year over Babylon; conventionally 538 BCE
events.review_status: Compatible setting; the Cylinder does not name Judah or date this return

events.title: The census in Luke’s birth narrative
events.traditional_date: Herod-era birth setting; before his conventionally dated death in 4 BCE

events.title: Theudas’s revolt in Gamaliel’s speech
events.traditional_date: Before Judas’s census revolt in the sequence of Acts 5:36–37
events.academic_consensus: Josephus places Theudas under Fadus: 44–46 CE
